caption: The drawing features two objects depicted in shades of brown on a plain beige background. The first object, positioned at the top center, is a circular stamp or mold with a carved image of a basket containing stylized flowers and leaves, surrounded by a ring of small dot-like impressions. The second object, located below and to the right of the first, is a wooden stamp with a handle, shown at a slight angle to display both the cylindrical side and the carved face, which features the same basket and flower pattern as the top object. The handle is plain and smooth, gradually tapering from the stamp’s face to a rounded end. The artist's name, "Charlotte Angus," is written in small, uppercase letters below the objects, slightly to the left of the handle. The composition is simple, with both objects centrally arranged on the otherwise empty background.
title: Pa. German Butter Mold
